In solo, are the two cards gained through this base effect selected from one initial draw or two?
wording_refinements.old_answer: The using Spirit gains one of the cards the target did not keep, rather than making a fresh draw. In solo the two kept cards come from the same initial draw of four. Any Major actually gained still incurs its own ordinary Forget requirement.
wording_refinements.new_answer: The using Spirit gains one of the cards the target did not keep, rather than making a fresh draw. In solo the two cards gained through this base effect come from the same initial draw of four. Any Major actually gained still incurs its own ordinary Forget requirement.
wording_refinements.reason: The ordinary Major Forgetting cost can remove a card just gained. “Two kept cards” could be misread as two cards necessarily retained in hand after costs. The refinement asks only the selection cohort of the two gains. It does not change their eligible source or any existing entry.
